statusLegend.ready: Implemented, reachable through the product surface, covered by meaningful automated checks, and has runtime evidence appropriate to the behavior.
statusLegend.partial: Some core behavior exists, but user reachability, persistence proof, negative checks, device evidence, or production fidelity is missing.
statusLegend.not_ready: Required behavior is missing, not reachable, or contradicted by implementation.

readinessRule: A model object, status enum, protocol, trace event, or test injection is not implementation evidence unless a production runtime path can cause the behavior from a user action.

behaviors.title: Text item import or creation
behaviors.userPath: Home -> Create Item -> Create And Start
behaviors.durableEffect: item record and session record stored in SQLite
positiveEvidence: App/SpokenMarginsAppUITests/Gate1FlowUITests.swift: test smoke covers seeded start, not imported item
Manual code inspection: imported item status is needs_listening_map and starts a session
falsificationFindings: No UI test creates a new imported item and inspects persisted item/session state.
External reference is hardcoded to manual-import; the user cannot enter the external reference described by the export flow.

behaviors.title: Load existing Listening Map
behaviors.userPath: Seeded item opens with resolved chapters
behaviors.durableEffect: ListeningMap loaded from fixture/SQLite and reflected in session snapshot
positiveEvidence: TraceReplayTests covers traces seeded with fixtures/maps/valid-listening-map.json
falsificationFindings: UI smoke test verifies timeline exists but not that map rows are loaded from durable map data.

behaviors.title: Manual Listening Map generation in app
behaviors.durableEffect: ListeningMap saved and item status promoted to ready
falsificationFindings: Generated map is deterministic sentence splitting, not provider-backed AI Listening Map generation.
Manual paste validation now exists, but provider-backed strict JSON generation remains unproven.
No UI test presses Generate Listening Map and verifies the new rows.

behaviors.title: Listening Map validation and repair reports
behaviors.userPath: Item detail -> Listening Map JSON -> Apply Listening Map JSON
behaviors.durableEffect: valid ListeningMap saved and item status promoted to ready; invalid maps are rejected before persistence
positiveEvidence: scripts/validate-contracts.py validates repository fixtures against JSON Schema
Gate1AppModel.parseListeningMapJSON requires schemaVersion listening-map.v1, overview, chapters, unique ids, title, description, and resolvable anchors
Gate1FlowUITests.testManualListeningMapJSONCanBeAppliedFromItemScreen applies valid map JSON through the product surface
SessionKitCoreTests.testSQLiteStoreReplacesListeningMapForItem verifies a newly applied map becomes the active item map
negativeEvidence: No UI test pastes malformed maps through the product surface.
No structured repair report model exists beyond user-visible validation errors.
falsificationFindings: Product validation exists but does not yet provide a multi-issue repair report or provider-output repair loop.

behaviors.title: Mapless playback and mapless interjection/export usefulness
behaviors.userPath: Create imported item without map -> playback
behaviors.corePath: SessionEngine.startSession with currentMap nil; buildExport without Listening Map
behaviors.durableEffect: session and interjections can exist without map
falsificationFindings: No UI test validates imported mapless playback or mapless export.
Current UI timeline empty state does not expose mapless interjection evidence until recording is performed.

behaviors.title: TTS URL cleanup while preserving source text
behaviors.userPath: Create/start item containing raw URL and Markdown link
behaviors.durableEffect: source item text unchanged; spoken text stripped of URLs
falsificationFindings: Core behavior is covered; runtime audible evidence is not captured.

behaviors.title: App-owned TTS production playback
behaviors.durableEffect: playback snapshot should only report playing after native playback starts
negativeEvidence: No device evidence proves AVSpeechSynthesizer actually starts before the playing snapshot is published.
No progress callback updates Session.position while long text is being spoken.
falsificationFindings: Playback now restarts from requested offsets and selects Siri/enhanced voices where available, but hardware/audio-route evidence is still required.

behaviors.title: Play/pause preserves source position
behaviors.durableEffect: session position unchanged across pause/resume
falsificationFindings: The test verifies SessionKit position and adapter offset requests, but no device evidence proves natural pause/resume over a long article.

behaviors.title: Tap chapter jumps to resolved chapter anchor
behaviors.userPath: Item chapter rows or playback timeline chapter rows
behaviors.durableEffect: session.position.charOffset/chapterId/completionPercent updated
negativeEvidence: No UI test taps chapter row and checks resulting state.
No device evidence proves the audible transition feels natural.
falsificationFindings: SessionKit now asks audio to restart from the chapter offset, but this still needs UI/device validation.

behaviors.title: Skip back/forward moves predictably
behaviors.durableEffect: session.position moves to semantic boundaries and stays within boundaries
positiveEvidence: Gate1FlowUITests taps back/forward and checks status messages
negativeEvidence: UI test does not inspect position movement.
No tests cover skip while recording, finished, loading, or paused.
No device evidence proves repeated skip feels predictable.
falsificationFindings: Core state movement now restarts audio from the new offset; product feel remains unvalidated.

behaviors.title: Begin interjection pauses playback and starts recording
behaviors.durableEffect: session phase recording_interjection; recording target and anchor captured
positiveEvidence: TraceReplayTests covers beginInterjection in multiple traces
negativeEvidence: No UI/device test grants microphone permission and records.
No failure-path test for recording permission denied in UI.
falsificationFindings: Simulator traces use mock recording; production recording is not validated on hardware.

behaviors.title: Done saves audio, creates interjection, schedules transcription, resumes
behaviors.durableEffect: interjection record saved with audioPath, transcriptionStatus pending, scheduler called, session resumes
negativeEvidence: No concrete speech-recognition transcriber exists.
No UI/device test verifies a durable m4a file on disk.
No negative test proves active interjection is not created when audio save fails.
falsificationFindings: The scheduler hook is present, but transcription is deferred/no-op by default.

behaviors.title: Cancel interjection discards audio and resumes
behaviors.durableEffect: recording is discarded, no interjection record is created, playback resumes from rollback point
negativeEvidence: No UI/device test validates Cancel with a real recording.
falsificationFindings: Cancel is implemented and reachable; real recording evidence is still needed.

behaviors.title: Rollback/resume reorients listener after interjection
behaviors.corePath: SessionEngine.finishInterjection sets charOffset to previous sentence
behaviors.durableEffect: session position rolls back and phase resumes
negativeEvidence: Rollback policy is not stored with session or package.
No runtime audio evidence proves listener hears enough rollback context.
falsificationFindings: Audio is now asked to restart from the rolled-back offset; policy configurability and device evidence remain.

behaviors.title: At least five interjections in one session
behaviors.durableEffect: five active interjections linked to same session
negativeEvidence: No UI/device test records five real interjections.
Generated interjection IDs are count-based and may collide after deletion or concurrent writes.
falsificationFindings: Core trace exists; production recording loop has not been validated.

behaviors.title: Timeline ordering, chapter/interjection rows, detail, delete transcript/interjection
behaviors.durableEffect: timeline rows should be sorted and detail actions should mutate interjection records
negativeEvidence: Chapter rows omit one-line description.
No UI test opens interjection detail or exercises delete actions.
falsificationFindings: Timeline sort/detail/delete paths are now present, but need UI test and description metadata support.

behaviors.title: Async transcription pending/transcribed/failed lifecycle

behaviors.durableEffect: interjection transcript/cleanedTranscript fields updated without losing audio
negativeEvidence: No device/simulator test records audio and proves Speech.framework returns a transcript.
No cleanup/summarization pass runs after raw transcription.
falsificationFindings: Transcription is no longer just a trace injection, but it still needs runtime evidence with real audio.

Summary and follow-up calls route through summaryModel and conversationModel
